claude.rationale: This was a whole-company reverse triangular merger in which the Company survived intact as a wholly owned subsidiary; the slice states the customer-facing product, the fresh-dough supplying process, and franchise relationships "all remained within the single surviving corporation at closing" with "no separated tier or transitional-services carve-out," so product (T4) and its producing/delivering processes (T5) moved together — gap_45 = 0. Likewise the operations passed intact alongside the people, with Parent contractually providing one year of substantially comparable benefits to continuing employees, so T5 and organization/people (T6) transferred coherently — gap_56 = 0. Because no gap is coded, gap_mitigated = NA. T1 is replace: board/governance control passed to the acquirer at closing (JAB) while the prior controlling principal exited.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company cash acquisition where the Company's existing business segments, franchise network, and fresh-dough supply operations passed intact into the surviving corporation with no separated tier or transitional-services carve-out. Therefore, there is no structural mismatch between the product (T4) and process (T5), nor between the process (T5) and organization (T6).

openai.rationale: The business-as-structured line states that the customer-facing product, fresh-dough supplying process, and franchise relationships remained together in the single surviving corporation, with no segment carved out or separated; therefore gap_45 is 0. The structural summary states that the whole company, including its fresh-dough operations, passed intact and that employee continuity was contractually addressed through one year of substantially comparable compensation and benefits, so no closing-time process-versus-organization mismatch is documented and gap_56 is 0.
